content.title: Cryptos’ Weak Pulse May Be Early Warning Sign. What the Charts of Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana Suggest
content.summary: After rocketing through six figures earlier this year,  Bitcoin  has entered a phase of cautious consolidation.  Institutional interest remains elevated, but traders are now watching closely to see whether the pullback is a healthy reset or the start of something more sinister.  Bitcoin remains one of the market’s favorite risk on barometers, and its recent weakness may be the canary in the coal mine on that front.
